about_zh: 代理、隧道、DNS、下载——让流量按你的意思走。

repos.description: A fast reverse proxy to help you expose a local server behind a NAT or firewall to the internet.
repos.summary_zh: frp 是一款高性能反向代理工具，专为穿透 NAT 或防火墙设计，支持 TCP、UDP、HTTP、HTTPS 协议转发，提供 P2P 连接模式。具备多协议支持、自定义域名访问内网服务、SSH 穿透、HTTP 文件服务器暴露、HTTPS 加密转发、私有服务暴露、Prometheus 监控、客户端认证等核心功能，适用于远程开发、内网服务访问、IoT 设备连接等场景。
repos.summary_en: frp is a high-performance reverse proxy designed to expose local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols, with P2P connectivity. Key features include multi-protocol forwarding, custom domain access to internal services, SSH tunneling, HTTP file server exposure, HTTPS encryption, private service exposure, Prometheus monitoring, and client authentication, ideal for remote development and IoT access.

repos.description: A V2Ray client for Android, support Xray core and v2fly core
repos.summary_zh: v2rayNG 是一款专为 Android 平台设计的 V2Ray 客户端，全面支持 Xray 和 v2fly 核心。它提供了强大的代理功能与灵活的 GeoIP/Geosite 路由规则管理，采用 Kotlin 编写，具备 GPG 签名校验机制，是移动端科学上网的优选工具。
repos.summary_en: v2rayNG is a robust V2Ray client for Android, fully supporting Xray and v2fly cores. It offers powerful proxy capabilities with flexible GeoIP/Geosite routing management. Written in Kotlin and featuring GPG signature verification, it is a top-tier solution for mobile network proxying.

repos.description: :arrow_double_down: Dumb downloader that scrapes the web
repos.summary_zh: You-Get 是一个轻量级命令行工具，用于从互联网下载视频、音频和图片内容，尤其适用于无官方下载渠道的网站。支持 YouTube、优酷等主流平台，具备流媒体播放、字幕下载及网页图片抓取功能，依赖 Python 和 FFmpeg，是开源的网页内容抓取工具。
repos.summary_en: You-Get is a lightweight command-line utility to download media (videos, audios, images) from the web when no official download option exists. It supports platforms like YouTube and Youku, enables streaming playback, subtitle extraction, and image scraping, and relies on Python and FFmpeg as core dependencies.

repos.description: A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: FlClash 是一款基于 ClashMeta 的多平台代理客户端，支持 Android、Windows、macOS 和 Linux，具备 Material You 设计、深色模式、WebDAV 数据同步及订阅链接管理功能，界面简洁无广告，适用于需要跨平台网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: FlClash is a multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta, supporting Android, Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features Material You design, dark mode, WebDAV sync, subscription management, and an ad-free, open-source interface for seamless cross-device proxy control.

repos.description: A shadowsocks client for Android
repos.summary_zh: Shadowsocks Android 是一款基于 Kotlin 开发的开源代理客户端，支持 Android 和 Chrome OS 平台。该应用提供安全、快速的科学上网功能，采用 Shadowsocks 协议加密传输数据，兼容多种服务器配置，具备自动切换、流量统计等实用功能，适用于需要隐私保护和网络访问的场景。
repos.summary_en: Shadowsocks Android is an open-source proxy client built with Kotlin for Android and Chrome OS. It enables secure and fast internet access using the Shadowsocks protocol, supporting multiple server configurations, automatic switching, and traffic monitoring for enhanced privacy and network freedom.

repos.description: A proxy tool to bypass GFW.
repos.summary_zh: XX-Net 是一款运行9年的成熟翻墙工具，支持全平台多设备同时使用。其核心优势在于独创的流量混淆技术，能完美模拟Chrome浏览器行为，实现隐身级网络穿透。软件内置ChatGPT服务，提供百万级token额度，兼具隐私保护与AI生产力工具属性。
repos.summary_en: XX-Net is a mature 9-year-old circumvention tool supporting multi-platform simultaneous connections. Its core strength lies in proprietary traffic obfuscation that mimics Chrome browser behavior for stealthy network bypass. The software integrates built-in ChatGPT with one million free tokens per plan, combining privacy protection with AI productivity features.

repos.description: Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.
repos.summary_zh: Hiddify 是一款跨平台代理客户端，基于 Sing-box 构建，支持 Vless、Vmess、Reality、TUIC、Hysteria、WireGuard、SSH 等多种协议。具备自动节点选择、TUN 模式、远程配置同步等功能，界面简洁、无广告、开源安全，支持多语言及深色/浅色主题，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: Hiddify is a multi-platform proxy client built on Sing-box, supporting Vless, Vmess, Reality, TUIC, Hysteria, WireGuard, SSH, and more. It features automatic node selection, TUN mode, remote configuration sync, and an intuitive UI. Open-source, ad-free, and secure, it's available on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

repos.description: Professional Antigravity Account Manager & Switcher. One-click seamless account switching for Antigravity Tools. Built with Tauri v2 + React (Rust).专业的 Antigravity 账号管理与切换工具。为 Antigravity 提供一键无缝账号切换功能。
repos.summary_zh: Antigravity-Manager 是一款专业的 AI 账号管理与协议代理系统，基于 Tauri v2 + Rust + React 构建。提供多账号无缝切换、OAuth 2.0 授权、智能配额监控、协议转换（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）、模型路由与后台任务静默降级等核心功能，打造高性能本地 AI 中转网关。
repos.summary_en: Antigravity-Manager is a professional AI account management and protocol proxy system built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React. It enables seamless multi-account switching, OAuth 2.0 authorization, intelligent quota monitoring, protocol conversion (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), model routing, and silent background task fallback, serving as a high-performance local AI proxy gateway.

repos.description: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

repos.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.
repos.summary_zh: Clash Party 是一款基于 Electron 的 Mihomo（Clash Meta）图形界面客户端，提供开箱即用的代理管理工具。支持 Smart Core 智能节点选择、多主题 UI、WebDAV 配置备份、Sub-Store 订阅集成及内核切换，简化了复杂代理配置流程，适合需要高效网络代理的用户。
repos.summary_en: Clash Party is an Electron-based GUI for Mihomo (Clash Meta) that offers an out-of-the-box proxy management tool. It features Smart Core AI-driven node selection, multi-theme UI, WebDAV config backup, Sub-Store integration, and dual-core support, streamlining complex proxy configurations for end users.

repos.description: http下载工具，基于http代理，支持多连接分块下载
repos.summary_zh: Proxyee Down 是一款基于 HTTP 代理和 Netty 的高性能开源下载工具，支持多线程分块下载，具备扩展功能以满足特殊需求。项目因 Java 客户端开发限制暂停维护，作者计划用 Go + Flutter 重写以打造跨平台、低内存占用的下一代下载器。
repos.summary_en: Proxyee Down is an open-source, high-speed HTTP downloader built on HTTP proxy and Netty, supporting multi-threaded chunked downloads and extensible plugins. The project is paused due to Java client limitations, with plans to rewrite using Go + Flutter for cross-platform, low-memory usage.

repos.description: Python ProxyPool for web spider
repos.summary_zh: ProxyPool 是一个 Python 实现的爬虫代理 IP 池，支持定时采集、验证和更新免费代理 IP，提供 RESTful API 接口。项目具备高可用代理源扩展能力，适用于网页爬虫、数据采集等场景，支持多版本 Python 环境及 Docker 部署，显著提升爬虫反爬绕过效率。
repos.summary_en: ProxyPool is a Python-based proxy IP pool for web scraping, featuring automated collection, validation, and management of free proxies. It offers a RESTful API for integration with crawlers, supports extensible proxy sources, and enables efficient anti-scraping bypass via rotating IPs. Compatible with Python 2.7–3.11 and deployable via Docker.

repos.description: 一个基于 JavaScript 的网盘文件下载地址获取工具。基于【网盘直链下载助手】修改 ，支持 百度网盘 / 阿里云盘 / 中国移动云盘 / 天翼云盘 / 迅雷云盘 / 夸克网盘 / UC网盘 / 123云盘 八大网盘
repos.summary_zh: LinkSwift 是一款基于 JavaScript 的网盘直链提取工具，支持百度网盘、阿里云盘、中国移动云盘、天翼云盘、迅雷云盘、夸克网盘、UC网盘及123云盘八大平台。用户通过浏览器脚本即可快速获取文件真实下载地址，跳过官方客户端的限速与繁琐操作，大幅提升跨平台网盘文件下载效率。
repos.summary_en: LinkSwift is a JavaScript-based tool for extracting direct download links from major Chinese cloud drives, including Baidu Pan, Aliyun Drive, China Mobile Cloud, Tianyi Cloud, Xunlei, Quark, UC, and 123Pan. It enables users to bypass official client restrictions and obtain real file download URLs directly in the browser, significantly improving cross-platform download efficiency.

repos.description: ZeroNet - Decentralized websites using Bitcoin crypto and BitTorrent network
repos.summary_zh: ZeroNet 是一个去中心化网站平台，利用比特币加密和 BitTorrent 网络实现无中心托管。网站内容通过 P2P 网络分发，支持实时更新、Namecoin 域名、Tor 匿名访问及 TLS 加密，无需服务器即可永久运行，抗审查且用户即服务提供者。
repos.summary_en: ZeroNet is a decentralized web platform using Bitcoin cryptography and the BitTorrent network for censorship-resistant, peer-to-peer hosting. Sites run on users' devices, support real-time updates, .bit domains, Tor anonymity, and automatic peer discovery without relying on central servers.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: Clash Nyanpasu～(∠・ω< )⌒☆​
repos.summary_zh: Clash Nyanpasu 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的 Clash 网络代理图形界面客户端，支持 Clash Premium、Mihomo 和 Clash Rust 内核。提供多配置文件和 Provider 管理功能，采用 Google Material You 设计语言，具备深色/浅色主题切换，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: Clash Nyanpasu is a Tauri-based GUI client for Clash network proxy, supporting Clash Premium, Mihomo, and Clash Rust cores. It offers profile and provider management with Google Material You UI design, dark/light themes, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: A powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, which supports global settings, Interceptors, FormData, aborting and canceling a request, files uploading and downloading, requests timeout, custom adapters, etc.
repos.summary_zh: dio 是一个强大的 Dart 和 Flutter HTTP 客户端库，支持全局配置、拦截器、FormData、请求取消、文件上传下载、超时控制及自定义适配器。提供完整的 REST API 调用能力，适用于移动端和 Web 应用开发，具备高度可定制性和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: dio is a powerful HTTP client for Dart and Flutter, supporting global settings, interceptors, FormData, request cancellation, file uploads/downloads, timeouts, and custom adapters. It offers full REST API capabilities with high customization and cross-platform compatibility for mobile and web apps.

repos.description: proxychains ng (new generation) - a preloader which hooks calls to sockets in dynamically linked programs and redirects it through one or more socks/http proxies. continuation of the unmaintained proxychains project. the sf.net page is currently not updated, use releases from github release page instead.
repos.summary_zh: ProxyChains-NG 是原 proxychains 项目的现代化延续，通过 LD_PRELOAD 技术劫持动态链接程序的 socket 调用，强制流量经 SOCKS4/5 或 HTTP 代理转发。支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 等主流平台，具备 IPv6、DNAT、多线程优化等特性，适用于绕过网络限制的场景，但需谨慎使用以避免法律风险。
repos.summary_en: ProxyChains-NG is a modern successor to the original proxychains project, intercepting socket calls in dynamically linked programs via LD_PRELOAD to route traffic through SOCKS4/5 or HTTP proxies. It supports Linux, BSD, macOS, and other platforms, featuring IPv6, DNAT, and multithreading optimizations. Designed for bypassing network restrictions, it requires careful configuration and legal awareness.

repos.description: 微信视频号下载器
repos.summary_zh: 微信视频号下载器是一款轻量级跨平台工具，支持 Windows 和 macOS 系统，通过注入浏览器扩展实现一键下载视频号视频。无需登录或复杂配置，自动安装证书并启动代理服务，在微信 PC 端界面直接添加下载按钮，支持多画质选择，下载完成后自动展示文件信息，体积小巧且操作简便。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Channels Video Downloader is a lightweight cross-platform tool for Windows and macOS that enables one-click downloading of videos from WeChat Channels. It automatically installs certificates, starts a proxy service, and injects download buttons into the WeChat PC client interface. Users can select video quality (e.g., xWT111, xWT98) and download files with metadata displayed post-download, offering a simple and efficient experience.

repos.description: SEX IS ZERO (0), so, who wanna be the ONE (1), aha?
repos.summary_zh: hardseed 是一个从草榴和愛城论坛批量下载种子与图片的自动化工具，支持代理配置、文件名安全处理及智能重试机制，适用于资源抓取与离线保存，操作简单且适配多平台。
repos.summary_en: hardseed is a batch download utility for seeds and pictures from CaoLiu and AiCheng forums, featuring proxy support, safe filename handling, and intelligent retry logic, designed for efficient resource scraping and offline archiving with cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: HTTP proxy written in Go. COW can automatically identify blocked sites and use parent proxies to access.
repos.summary_zh: COW 是一个基于 Go 编写的智能 HTTP 代理工具，专为简化科学上网设计。它能自动识别被墙网站并仅对这些网站启用二级代理（如 Shadowsocks、SOCKS5 等），直连网站则绕过代理以提升访问速度。支持多类型二级代理、负载均衡、PAC 自动配置及访问行为学习，适用于移动设备或 APN 代理场景。
repos.summary_en: COW (Climb Over the Wall) is an intelligent HTTP proxy written in Go, designed to simplify bypassing internet restrictions. It automatically detects blocked websites and routes only those through secondary proxies (e.g., Shadowsocks, SOCKS5), while allowing direct access to uncensored sites for optimal speed. Features include multi-proxy support, load balancing, PAC generation, and adaptive learning of site accessibility patterns.

repos.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
repos.summary_zh: Tailcat 是基于 Tailscale 数据平面构建的类 netcat 工具，无需 Tailscale 账户或 root 权限即可建立 WireGuard 加密点对点隧道。支持 NAT 穿透、DERP 中继、文件传输与 WebAssembly 浏览器端，适用于安全跨网络通信场景。
repos.summary_en: Tailcat is a netcat-like tool built on Tailscale's data plane, enabling WireGuard-encrypted P2P tunnels without requiring a Tailscale account or root privileges. Features NAT traversal, DERP relays, file transfer, and a WebAssembly browser client for secure cross-network communication.

repos.description: 🚀 Free HTTP, SOCKS4, & SOCKS5 proxy list * Updated every 5 minutes * and rotating proxy API (100+ countries)
repos.summary_zh: Proxifly 是一个高性能的免费代理 IP 池，每 5 分钟自动抓取并验证全球 HTTP、HTTPS、SOCKS4 和 SOCKS5 代理。提供 JSON、TXT、CSV 多格式下载及 NPM 模块，支持按国家与协议筛选，适用于网页爬虫、数据抓取与隐私保护等场景。
repos.summary_en: Proxifly is a high-performance free proxy pool that automatically scrapes and validates global HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4, and SOCKS5 proxies every 5 minutes. It offers multi-format downloads (JSON, TXT, CSV), an NPM module, and filtering by country/protocol, ideal for web scraping, data extraction, and privacy protection.

repos.description: One-stop Proxies Crawling and Aggregation Platform
repos.summary_zh: Aggregator 是一个高效免费的代理池构建工具，支持从 Telegram、GitHub 等多平台爬取代理资源，自动验证质量并转换为 Clash、V2Ray 等格式，提供 GitHub Gist 等灵活存储后端，适用于个人及企业级代理订阅管理。
repos.summary_en: Aggregator is a powerful free proxy pool builder that crawls proxy resources from multiple platforms like Telegram and GitHub, automatically validates quality, and converts them into formats such as Clash and V2Ray. It supports flexible storage backends like GitHub Gist and is ideal for personal and enterprise proxy subscription management.

repos.description: p2p.kiwi 🥝, Cross-Platform screen 🖥️ sharing 📡 made simple ⚡.
repos.summary_zh: p2p.kiwi是一款跨平台P2P屏幕共享工具，支持Mac、Windows和Linux系统。无需注册账户，不依赖服务器基础设施，仅通过STUN/TURN及信令服务器完成初始连接交换。适合远程协作、技术支持与即时屏幕分享场景，实现高效安全的点对点数据传输。
repos.summary_en: p2p.kiwi is a cross-platform P2P screen sharing tool supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. No account registration required, operates without server infrastructure beyond STUN/TURN and signaling servers for initial connection setup. Ideal for remote collaboration, tech support, and instant screen sharing with secure peer-to-peer data transfer.

repos.description: Native Proxy Experience Built for macOS
repos.summary_zh: ClashMac 是一款专为 macOS 打造的本地代理客户端，采用 SwiftUI 原生开发，深度集成系统。提供航线地图、连接拓扑和流量统计三大核心可视化功能，支持系统代理与 TUN 增强模式，具备菜单栏常驻、隐私模式、实时切换和自动重连等特性，带来直观高效的代理管理体验。
repos.summary_en: ClashMac is a native macOS proxy client built with SwiftUI, offering route map visualization, connection topology, and real-time traffic statistics. It supports system proxy and TUN modes, features menu bar integration, privacy mode, instant node switching, and auto-reconnection for an intuitive proxy management experience.

repos.description: lanproxy是一个将局域网个人电脑、服务器代理到公网的内网穿透工具，支持tcp流量转发，可支持任何tcp上层协议（访问内网网站、本地支付接口调试、ssh访问、远程桌面、http代理、https代理、socks5代理...）。技术交流QQ群 736294209
repos.summary_zh: lanproxy 是一款高性能内网穿透工具，支持 TCP 流量转发，可代理访问内网网站、SSH、远程桌面等任何 TCP 上层协议。提供 Java 客户端和跨平台 Go 客户端，支持 SSL 加密、多用户管理、自定义域名绑定及 HTTPS 证书自动申请，解决公网访问内网服务的安全与便捷问题。
repos.summary_en: Lanproxy is a high-performance intranet penetration tool that supports TCP traffic forwarding for any TCP-based protocol (e.g., web access, SSH, remote desktop). It offers Java and cross-platform Go clients, with SSL encryption, multi-user support, custom domain binding, and automatic HTTPS certificate issuance, enabling secure and easy public access to private networks.

repos.description: 收集一些Loon、Surge、QuantumultX、ShadowRocket、Egern的配置与去广告规则。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Loon、Surge、Quantumult X 等代理工具的配置与去广告规则，涵盖抖音、微博等主流 App 的广告过滤与 IP 修改功能，支持 MITM 响应体解析，适用于净化网络环境，提升使用体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers configuration files and ad-blocking rules for Loon, Surge, Quantumult X, and other proxy tools, including ad removal for apps like Douyin and Weibo, with MITM-based response parsing to enhance browsing experience.

repos.description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go/React和WebRTC的端到端P2P文件传输工具，支持文件、文字传输及桌面共享，数据直连不经过服务器，具备端到端加密、响应式设计和Docker一键部署能力。
repos.summary_en: A secure, privacy-focused P2P file transfer tool built with Go/React and WebRTC, enabling direct file, text, and desktop sharing without server relay, featuring end-to-end encryption, responsive design, and Docker deployment.

repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR for Windows 是一款基于 ShadowsocksR 协议的跨平台代理工具，专为绕过网络审查设计。支持多服务器配置、系统级代理、PAC自动更新及UDP流量转发，提供完整的隐私保护和网络访问解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR for Windows is a cross-platform proxy tool based on the ShadowsocksR protocol, designed to bypass internet censorship. It supports multiple server configurations, system-wide proxy, automatic PAC updates, and UDP forwarding, offering comprehensive privacy protection and network access.

repos.description: IPProxyPool代理池项目，提供代理ip
repos.summary_zh: IPProxyPool是一个开源代理IP池项目，支持Python 2/3，提供高匿、匿名和透明代理IP抓取与验证服务。通过多线程爬虫自动采集代理源，结合评分机制筛选可用IP，支持HTTP/HTTPS协议及国内外地域过滤。项目采用SQLite默认数据库，可扩展至MySQL、MongoDB等，并提供RESTful API供外部调用，适用于爬虫、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: IPProxyPool is an open-source proxy IP pool project supporting Python 2/3, offering automated collection and validation of anonymous, high-anonymity, and transparent proxy IPs. It uses multi-threaded crawlers to gather proxies from multiple sources, filters them via a scoring system, and supports HTTP/HTTPS protocols with geographic filtering. Built on SQLAlchemy ORM, it defaults to SQLite but can be extended to MySQL or MongoDB. A RESTful API enables external access for use in web scraping and data collection applications.

repos.description: ShadowsocksR update rss, SSR organization https://github.com/shadowsocksr
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR C# 版本4.8.0 是一个全能代理工具，支持Socks4/4a/5、HTTP协议，具备节点统计、连接管理、UDP-over-TCP、多重代理及自定义协议插件功能。支持服务器订阅与自动更新，提供GPG签名校验确保安全性，适用于绕过网络限制与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR C# v4.8.0 is a comprehensive proxy tool supporting Socks4/4a/5, HTTP, with features like node statistics, connection management, UDP-over-TCP, multi-hop proxying, and custom protocol plugins. It supports server subscription with GPG signature verification for security, ideal for bypassing censorship and enhancing privacy.

repos.description: gfw_whitelist
repos.summary_zh: 该项目提供基于白名单的PAC代理配置方案，通过维护国内常用域名白名单，实现国内网站直连、境外网站走代理的科学上网模式。支持自动生成whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac三种格式的代理配置文件，兼容Chrome、Firefox等主流浏览器，支持SOCKS5/HTTPS等多种代理协议，并提供在线PAC生成服务。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a PAC proxy configuration solution based on whitelisting, allowing direct connection for domestic websites and proxy for international sites. It supports generating three types of proxy config files (whitelist.pac/whiteiplist.pac/proxy.pac), compatible with major browsers, supporting multiple proxy protocols like SOCKS5/HTTPS, and offers online PAC generation service.

repos.description: Give your localhost a local or public URL
repos.summary_zh: Slim 是一个 Go 编写的本地开发代理工具，为 localhost 服务提供干净的 HTTPS 自定义域名（如 myapp.test），支持多路由配置、CORS 和自动证书管理。同时可将本地服务安全暴露为公网 URL，便于远程调试与协作演示。
repos.summary_en: Slim is a Go-based local development proxy tool that assigns clean HTTPS custom domains (e.g., myapp.test) to localhost services. It supports multi-route configuration, CORS, and automatic certificate management. Additionally, it can securely expose local servers as public URLs for remote debugging and collaborative demos.

repos.description: 突破百度云限速合集，另外附带Baidu-Go、Tampermonkey、Proxyee-down教程。从此云端女友从不断线，有了这个它，忘掉那个她!
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供Aria2下载工具及百度网盘破解限速方案，集成BaiduPCS-Go、Tampermonkey脚本和Proxyee-down等工具，支持多平台下载加速，实现百度云资源高速下载，解决限速问题。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers Aria2 download tools and solutions to bypass Baidu Cloud speed limits, integrating BaiduPCS-Go, Tampermonkey scripts, and Proxyee-down for multi-platform accelerated downloads, enabling high-speed access to Baidu Cloud resources.

repos.description: python ip proxy tool  scrapy crawl. 抓取大量免费代理 ip，提取有效 ip 使用
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Scrapy 的 Python 代理 IP 抓取与验证工具，支持多源采集、异步验证、MySQL 存储及 RESTful 数据接口，提供高匿/匿名/透明代理筛选与 HTTPS 支持检测，适用于爬虫反爬、数据采集等场景。
repos.summary_en: A Python-based proxy IP crawler and validator using Scrapy, featuring multi-source scraping, asynchronous validation, MySQL storage, and RESTful API for filtering proxies by anonymity and HTTPS support, ideal for web scraping and anti-bot bypass.

repos.description: Obfuscate all your TCP connections into HTTP protocol.
repos.summary_zh: FakeHTTP 是一款基于 Netfilter Queue 的 TCP 连接混淆工具，可将任意 TCP 流量伪装成 HTTP/HTTPS 协议，有效绕过网络审查与深度包检测。支持自定义接口、目标主机、TTL 跳数及防火墙规则配置，适用于高级网络隐蔽通信场景。
repos.summary_en: FakeHTTP is a TCP connection obfuscation tool that disguises all TCP traffic as HTTP/HTTPS protocols using Netfilter Queue. It enables stealthy network communication by bypassing deep packet inspection and censorship, with support for custom interfaces, hostnames, TTL manipulation, and firewall rule integration.

repos.description: 人教社电子教材下载器
repos.summary_zh: FreePEP是一款人教社中小学电子教材批量下载工具，内置全量780+教材目录与AES解密引擎，自动破解WAF滑块验证码。支持WebUI与CLI双模式，提供多线程并发下载、断点续传及高清PDF合成功能，可一键获取指定学段、学科、年级的全套教材。
repos.summary_en: FreePEP is a batch downloader for People's Education Press textbooks, featuring 780+ built-in titles and an AES decryption engine. It automatically bypasses WAF CAPTCHA, supports dual WebUI/CLI modes, multi-threaded downloads with resumption, and high-quality PDF synthesis for quick textbook access.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX https://github.com/shadowsocks/shadowsocks-iOS
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 Shadowsocks 的下一代 macOS 客户端，提供高性能代理功能，支持 SSR 协议，适用于科学上网与隐私保护。项目因监管要求已停止维护，原代码存档于 shadowsocksr-backup 仓库。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, offering high-performance proxy capabilities with SSR protocol support for secure browsing and privacy protection. The project has been discontinued due to regulatory reasons, with archived code in the shadowsocksr-backup repository.

repos.description: Clash X
repos.summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
repos.summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

repos.description: Downloads : https://brahma-dev.github.io/synergy-stable-builds/
repos.summary_zh: Synergy 是一款开源的跨平台输入共享工具，允许用户通过一套键鼠无缝控制多台计算机。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，提供简洁的配置与编译流程，适用于多设备办公场景，强调自由使用与二次开发。
repos.summary_en: Synergy is an open-source, cross-platform tool that enables sharing a single mouse and keyboard across multiple computers. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with straightforward configuration and build processes, ideal for multi-device productivity environments.

repos.summary_zh: Shadowsocks 是一个高性能的 TCP/UDP 隧道代理工具，支持用户管理 API、TCP Fast Open 和 IP 黑名单，用于绕过网络防火墙，提供跨平台服务端与客户端支持，适用于 Linux、Windows、Android 及 OpenWRT 等环境。
repos.summary_en: Shadowsocks is a high-performance TCP/UDP tunnel proxy with features like user management API, TCP Fast Open, and IP blacklisting, designed to bypass firewalls. It supports cross-platform deployment on Linux, Windows, Android, and OpenWRT, offering both server and client implementations.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: A ShadowsocksR client for Android4.0+.Compatible Shadowsocks protocol and support some ShadowsocksR function.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksR Droid 是一款专为 Android 4.0+ 设备设计的 ShadowsocksR 客户端，兼容 Shadowsocks 协议并支持部分 ShadowsocksR 功能，采用 Kotlin 和 Java 开发，提供跨平台网络代理解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksR Droid is an Android 4.0+ client for ShadowsocksR, compatible with Shadowsocks protocol and supporting some ShadowsocksR features. Built with Kotlin and Java, it offers a cross-platform network proxy solution for enhanced privacy and access.

repos.description: ClashFX — macOS proxy tool with Enhanced Mode (TUN)
repos.summary_zh: ClashFX 是一款基于 mihomo 核心的 macOS 代理工具，支持 TUN 模式实现全局流量捕获，提供规则路由、多协议代理（VMess/VLESS/Trojan 等）、DNS 安全及 Apple Silicon 原生支持，适用于高级网络代理与隐私保护场景。
repos.summary_en: ClashFX is a macOS proxy client powered by the mihomo core, featuring TUN-based Enhanced Mode for system-wide traffic capture, rule-based routing, support for multiple protocols (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2), secure DNS with Fake-IP, and native Apple Silicon compatibility.

repos.summary_zh: 一个轻量级 VPN 配置生成工具，通过一条命令在 VPS 上自动生成支持 Reality 协议的节点配置，并输出二维码供 OneXray、Shadowrocket、Clash Meta 等主流客户端扫码一键导入，免去手动配置的繁琐流程。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight VPN config generator that creates Reality protocol-compatible node configurations via a single command. Outputs QR codes for seamless one-click import into popular clients like OneXray, Shadowrocket, and Clash Meta, eliminating manual setup.

repos.description: 节点过滤器
repos.summary_zh: ProxyFilter 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Clash 代理配置过滤工具，支持多格式输入（YAML、Base64、URI列表），智能匹配中英文地区名称，过滤 VMess、Shadowsocks、Trojan 等协议节点，自动去重并支持多源合并与自定义命名，适用于高效管理代理订阅。
repos.summary_en: ProxyFilter is a Cloudflare Workers-based tool for filtering Clash proxy configurations. It supports multiple input formats (YAML, Base64, URI lists), intelligently matches region names in Chinese and English, filters nodes by protocol (VMess, Shadowsocks, Trojan, etc.), removes duplicates, and merges multiple sources with customizable naming.

repos.description: A lightweight HTTP relay that forwards /{absolute-url} requests with optional proxy and traffic dump.
repos.summary_zh: http-relay 是一个轻量级 HTTP 中继工具，支持将形如 /{absolute-url} 的请求转发至目标地址，支持代理配置与流量抓包功能，适用于调试、代理转发及流量分析场景。
repos.summary_en: http-relay is a lightweight HTTP relay tool that forwards requests in the format /{absolute-url} to target URLs, supporting proxy configuration and traffic dumping for debugging, proxying, and traffic analysis.
